entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「Henken here. What is it?」

entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「What? Quitting? I
can take a break too?
...Understood, Brother Two!」

entries.speaker: Emma
entries.text:
Emma
「Is that the player's code name?」

entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「Something like that. Lieutenant
Emma, I'm off duty too. How
about some shopping...?」

entries.speaker: Emma
entries.text:
Emma
「Oh, Captain, even on a break,
surely you can't leave your ship?」

entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「Ghh...! Well, that's true, but...」

entries.speaker: Emma
entries.text:
Emma
「Well, I'll go on ahead...
Emma Sheen, taking a break!」

entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「Grrr! Calling Brother Two! Resume
the mission! Otherwise, I won't be
able to take my mind off this!」

entries.speaker: Henken
entries.text:
Henken
「Did you hear me?! Please resume
the mission! I'm counting on you!」

entries.speaker: Fa
entries.text:
Fa
「Kamille! Break that habit
of playing games while lying
down! It's bad manners!」

entries.speaker: Kamille
entries.text:
Kamille
「Oh, come on... Now that I'm on
leave... Can't you let me relax?」

entries.speaker: Fa
entries.text:
Fa
「No! One hour a day! Sit on
your heels, back straight, two
meters or more from the screen!」

entries.speaker: Kamille
entries.text:
Kamille
「...That's what Fa says, but
all you players should just
relax and enjoy the game.」

entries.speaker: Kamille
entries.text:
Kamille
「But it's true that it's
better to take a break
every one to two hours.」

entries.speaker: Kamille
entries.text:
Kamille
「If you feel tired, it's better
to take a break from playing,
just as you have now.」

entries.speaker: Fa
entries.text:
Fa
「Come on, Kamille, you need to
stop now too! I'll turn it off!」

entries.speaker: Kamille
entries.text:
Kamille
「Whoa, not yet! Wait...」

entries.speaker: Loran
entries.text:
Loran
「All you players! Super Robot
Wars is a game that really makes
you wonder what happens next.」

entries.speaker: Loran
entries.text:
Loran
「Hurry back!」

entries.speaker: Loran
entries.text:
Loran
「Super Robot Wars is a
game that really makes you
wonder what happens next!」

entries.speaker: Loran
entries.text:
Loran
「Everyone! Hurry baaaack!!」

entries.speaker: Garrod
entries.text:
Garrod
「Tiffa! Hey, Tiffa! Come
over here and say a few
words before we finish!」

entries.speaker: Tiffa
entries.text:
Tiffa
「Huh? Me...? W-well then...」

entries.speaker: Tiffa
entries.text:
Tiffa
「...Please... promise me. Promise
you'll come back, no matter what.
So this fighting can end soon...」

entries.speaker: Garrod
entries.text:
Garrod
「Lucky you, getting a
message from Tiffa! I'll
guarantee your good fortune!」

entries.speaker: Garrod
entries.text:
Garrod
「Luck is always there! See you!」

entries.speaker: Jamil
entries.text:
Jamil
「Is the moon out?」

entries.speaker: Sara
entries.text:
Sara
「Huh?」

entries.speaker: Jamil
entries.text:
Jamil
「I'm asking whether
the moon is out!」

entries.speaker: Toniya
entries.text:
Toniya
「Sorry... our captain is
a little fussy when it
comes to the moon...」

entries.speaker: Toniya
entries.text:
Toniya
「Sorry, once you quit, could
you go outside and check? That
might calm things down...」

entries.speaker: Sara
entries.text:
Sara
「Sorry for the trouble.
Please help. We'll await your
next game and your report.」

entries.speaker: Shinn
entries.text:
Shinn
「What are you thinking,
stopping here?!」

entries.speaker: Rey
entries.text:
Rey
「Stop it, Shinn!」

entries.speaker: Shinn
entries.text:
Shinn
「Here, of all places...
Stopping here... I just...!」

entries.speaker: Lunamaria
entries.text:
Lunamaria
「Getting angry just because
the game's being paused...」

entries.speaker: Meyrin
entries.text:
Meyrin
「Seriously, Shinn is such a child.」

entries.speaker: Lunamaria
entries.text:
Lunamaria
「Players, don't throw
tantrums like that when the
game doesn't go your way!」

entries.speaker: Meyrin
entries.text:
Meyrin
「Now then, get some good rest!」

entries.speaker: Lunamaria
entries.text:
Lunamaria
「Thanks for playing!」

entries.speaker: Gainer
entries.text:
Gainer
「Three in a squad... Me,
Sara, and the last one...
It'd have to be that one...」

entries.speaker: Sara
entries.text:
Sara
「Gainer! The player's quitting,
but you're still playing Super
Robot Wars?! Let me see!」

entries.speaker: Gainer
entries.text:
Gainer
「N-no, I mean it, Sara!」

entries.speaker: Sara
entries.text:
Sara
「!! So that's your squad.
Fine. You're at that age. It's
your game. Do as you like!」

entries.speaker: Gainer
entries.text:
Gainer
「Sorry, player! I'm
going to go apologize!」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「Good grief... As always, their
fights are embarrassing to watch.
One last tip before I go.」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「Name the heroine after your
crush, and friends seeing your
save will embarrass you. See you!」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「Enemies keep landing
10% shots? Just bad luck.
Nobody's to blame. See you!」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「I hear the 'Tin Goldfish' sells
for a high price at the bazaar
after Episode 41. See you!」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「If you think the game is too hard,
don't go for SR Points. See you!」

entries.speaker: Gain
entries.text:
Gain
「Just between us, Gainer
is... Whoops! Looks like
he's back. See you!」

entries.speaker: Ana
entries.text:
Ana
「Whaaat?! You're stopping
already?! After taking poor me
hostage, too! How meeean!」

entries.speaker: Ana
entries.text:
Ana
「But you all have your
own lives to lead, so I
suppose it can't be helped.」

entries.speaker: Ana
entries.text:
Ana
「Next time you play, play
lots and lots, okay?」

entries.speaker: Ana
entries.text:
Ana
「But! Playing too much like
Gainer used to is a no-no!」

entries.speaker: Enge
entries.text:
Enge
「How's your game coming along?」

entries.speaker: Kejinan
entries.text:
Kejinan
「...I'm bored. Enge, take over.」

entries.speaker: Enge
entries.text:
Enge
「No way! We only switched
ten minutes ago!」

entries.speaker: Kejinan
entries.text:
Kejinan
「Absurd! Maxing out funds
in Episode 2 by getting
wiped out over and over!」

entries.speaker: Jaboli
entries.text:
Jaboli
「Stop arguing and get on with it!
This is President Kizz's save data!」

entries.speaker: Kejinan
entries.text:
Kejinan
「Why play on the president's
save?! Even a fun game
gets boring like this!!」

entries.speaker: Jaboli
entries.text:
Jaboli
「You at the screen...
Some people are like this.
I hope you enjoy playing.」

entries.speaker: Raita
entries.text:
Raita
「Quitting already?! You wimp!
Commander Tsukikage's hellish
drills will give you backbone!」

entries.speaker: Oliver
entries.text:
Oliver
「You've got a nerve, Raita. Who was
the first to start whining during
our last special training session?」

entries.speaker: Raita
entries.text:
Raita
「Th-that was, well, um...」

entries.speaker: Marin
entries.text:
Marin
「Come on, it's all right. It's not
as though this is goodbye forever to
everyone in front of the screen.」

entries.speaker: Raita
entries.text:
Raita
「Y-yeah, you're right! Let's
leave it here for now!」

entries.speaker: Marin
entries.text:
Marin
「To help save this planet's
future, get some good rest.」

entries.speaker: Oliver
entries.text:
Oliver
「Be sure to come
back and play again!」

entries.speaker: Raita
entries.text:
Raita
「Good work!」

???
「Super Robot Wars... An endlessly
expanding sea of robot stories...」

???
「What fate awaits Super Robot
Wars Z? What fate awaits
Marin... and the player?」

???
「The player entered a
world of merged dimensions
and endless conflict.」

???
「As desperate battles rage, foes
keep coming... What awaits the
player at this struggle's end?」

???
「Please look forward to more
Super Robot Wars Z next time.」

entries.speaker: Kiraken
entries.text:
Kiraken
「...No good! Clearing this stage
would open the way to Io, but...」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「Hand it over! If we leave
it to Kiraken, we'll never
save everyone on Io!」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「Now, now... Don't get
so worked up, you two.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「What is it, Julie?
Don't tell me you...」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「200, in cash. If you want to know
how to beat Super Robot Wars, you'll
have to pay at least that much.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「Tch! What a greedy bastard.」

entries.speaker: Kiraken
entries.text:
Kiraken
「As if I'd rely on the likes
of Julie! I'll play all night
with guts and determination!」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「...Good grief. You in front of
the screen, please don't follow
clever Mr. Kira's example.」

entries.speaker: Kiraken
entries.text:
Kiraken
「...Haaah, this is hopeless...
There are so many numbers,
I don't know what to do.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「What's up? Kiraken, are you
having trouble with upgrades?」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「Upgrade a unit's strengths:
Mobility for dodgers, and even
more Armor for armored units.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「Ugh! Now you're trying
to sell us lessons?!」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「Relax, no tuition fee. If
Kiraken doesn't learn, my
life will be at risk too.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「While you're at it, Julie,
tell us the shortcut from here
to the final stage, too.」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「Toshiya... You and the player
will have to find that with
your own wits and courage.」

entries.speaker: Toshiya
entries.text:
Toshiya
「I'd be less of a man if I
backed down after hearing that!
Time to start again, right now!」

entries.speaker: Julie
entries.text:
Julie
「Good grief... That defeats the
whole purpose of this screen...」

???
「Next time! Worlds collide!
Clashing cultures and
technologies cause panic!」

???
「Just what is the connection
between this incident
and Trinity Energy?」

???
「Next time on Super Robot
Wars Z: 'Who's the Narrator?'
Look forward to it!」

entries.speaker: Dalton
entries.text:
Dalton
「This side job... If Supreme
Commander Gagarn finds
out, I'll be a goner...」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「Oh, you're stopping the game?
Long gaming sessions put a strain
on your eyes. A wise decision.」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「Earth's peace is in your
hands. Recover your strength
before the next battle.」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「Well then, take your
time and get some rest.」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「...Phew...」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「...Hee hee hee...! Those nuisances
are gone. Now I reign supreme!」

entries.speaker: Kazami
entries.text:
Kazami
「Hee hee hee!
Heee-hee-hee-hee-hee-hee...!」

entries.speaker: Anemone
entries.text:
Anemone
「No! I can't stand it!
Let me play some more!」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「Don't be selfish! I told
you, didn't I?! Only one
hour of gaming a day!」

entries.speaker: Anemone
entries.text:
Anemone
「Are you seriously saying that?!
How many days do you think it'll
take to finish at that rate?!」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「Play a little at a time
and you'll reach the ending
eventually! So, for today...!」

entries.speaker: Anemone
entries.text:
Anemone
「Fine, then! Dominic, you
idiot! I'm going to bed!」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「...I had no other choice,
Anemone. When you start playing,
you won't even look my way...」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「I don't mind being insulted
or hit. As long as you'll
pay attention to me...」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「...Uh-oh... This guy's
the real thing...」

entries.speaker: Matthieu
entries.text:
Matthieu
「Huh? Stoner, whatcha doing?」

entries.speaker: Stoner
entries.text:
Stoner
「Can't you see? I'm saving
the data from this session
to a Memory Card (PS2).」

entries.speaker: Matthieu
entries.text:
Matthieu
「No way! Seriously?! You've been
the one doing that, Stoner?!」

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.text:
Hilda
「Of course not! Don't
believe everything so easily!」

entries.speaker: Gidget
entries.text:
Gidget
「That's right! The little
people inside the console
do that sort of thing!」

entries.speaker: Moondoggie
entries.text:
Moondoggie
「Gidget... What you're
saying ain't right either...」

entries.speaker: Talho
entries.text:
Talho
「Geez! Suspending the game here?
You leave everything half-finished!」

entries.speaker: Ken-Goh
entries.text:
Ken-Goh
「Be reasonable, Talho. Don't
blame the player here. You
should thank them! Thank them!」

entries.speaker: Talho
entries.text:
Talho
「But...」

entries.speaker: Hap
entries.text:
Hap
「Besides, what will you do
if your hysterics make the
players lose the will to play?」

entries.speaker: Holland
entries.text:
Holland
「Don't worry, Hap. Super Robot Wars
players aren't chickens who'd back
down over something like this.」

entries.speaker: Talho
entries.text:
Talho
「That's our leader! Such a
big heart... and forehead!」

entries.speaker: Holland
entries.text:
Holland
「Y-you...! You said the
one thing you shouldn't!」

entries.speaker: Talho
entries.text:
Talho
「Everyone playing, come
back as soon as you can!」

entries.speaker: Talho
entries.text:
Talho
「Otherwise, Holland's forehead
will just keep getting wider!」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「S-so that means the
save is complete...?」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「Yeah. All that's left is to turn
off the console, and you're done.」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「Then how do I
resume the game?!」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「Turn on the console and
choose Continue or Load
on the title screen.」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「All right, let's try it... ...What's
going on?! It isn't working!!」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「Could it be because
this is missing?」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「The Memory Card (PS2)!!!」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「If you want it back, trade me a
brand-new pair of Kurie sneakers!」

entries.speaker: Dominic
entries.text:
Dominic
「What?! N-no way!」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「Ohhh! I'm seriously moved that
you've played this far! I'll work
just as hard as all of you, too!!」

entries.speaker: Moondoggie
entries.text:
Moondoggie
「Renton, enough gushing.
Your excess zeal is
putting the player off.」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「Big Bro Doggie, how can you
say that?! Overwhelming passion is
the soul of Super Robot Wars!」

entries.speaker: Moondoggie
entries.text:
Moondoggie
「Is that how it is? ...What
do you think, Eureka?」

entries.speaker: Eureka
entries.text:
Eureka
「It might be... a little annoying...」

entries.speaker: Renton
entries.text:
Renton
「...Sis... Here I am, with nobody
understanding this passion...
It's extremely rough...!」

entries.speaker: Apollo
entries.text:
Apollo
「Hey, hey! You're quitting here?!
I still haven't had my fill!」

entries.speaker: Sirius
entries.text:
Sirius
「Enough, Apollo! Not everyone
is as tough as you!」

entries.speaker: Silvia
entries.text:
Silvia
「That's right! Don't expect
everyone to be like Apollo!」

entries.speaker: Apollo
entries.text:
Apollo
「Hah! I don't want to hear
that from Silvia, who broke the
controller with her brute strength!」

entries.speaker: Sirius
entries.text:
Sirius
「I won't allow you
to insult my sister!!」

entries.speaker: Apollo
entries.text:
Apollo
「And I don't want to hear
it from Sirius, either, with
all his nervous resets!」

entries.speaker: Silvia
entries.text:
Silvia
「Brother! But you said
playing by resetting was
refusing to accept defeat!」

entries.speaker: Sirius
entries.text:
Sirius
「Ugh...」

entries.speaker: Apollo
entries.text:
Apollo
「Players, do as you like!
I'm still not satisfied,
but see you next time!」

entries.speaker: Pierre
entries.text:
Pierre
「Hey, good work!」

entries.speaker: Tsugumi
entries.text:
Tsugumi
「Oh, you're suspending the game?
Thanks for all your hard work!」

entries.speaker: Jun
entries.text:
Jun
「Too much of anything isn't good
for you. Please take a good rest.」

entries.speaker: Pierre
entries.text:
Pierre
「Then it's time to get that
out-of-practice body moving!」

entries.speaker: Tsugumi
entries.text:
Tsugumi
「What?! But the player's tired!」

entries.speaker: Jun
entries.text:
Jun
「Come on, let's let them rest!」

entries.speaker: Pierre
entries.text:
Pierre
「Oh, all right... Hey, you! Get some
exercise once in a while, whether
it's soccer or anything else!」

entries.speaker: Rena
entries.text:
Rena
「Oh... You ended the game
by following the proper
procedure. How unusual...」

entries.speaker: Rena
entries.text:
Rena
「I'm sorry, after you've taken the
trouble to come here, but all I can
do is tell prophecies... Here goes...」

entries.speaker: Rena
entries.text:
Rena
「Short on funds... Luck saves
you... Bless rings beside you...
Spirit makes luck yours...」

entries.speaker: Rena
entries.text:
Rena
「...That is all I could see. Until
we meet again, somewhere...」

entries.speaker: Reika
entries.text:
Reika
「Ah... To be sent to a place like
this... How unlucky can I be...?」

entries.speaker: Fudo
entries.text:
Fudo
「You fool!!」

entries.speaker: Reika
entries.text:
Reika
「!?」

entries.speaker: Fudo
entries.text:
Fudo
「Be glad you appear at all. Here,
true misfortune is being forgotten!」

entries.speaker: Reika
entries.text:
Reika
「Yes... If bad luck is my
defining trait, someone will
always remember me...!」

entries.speaker: Fudo
entries.text:
Fudo
「A strength can become a
weakness, and a weakness can
become a strength. Remember that.」

entries.speaker: Reika
entries.text:
Reika
「Y-yes! Thank you!」

entries.speaker: Fudo
entries.text:
Fudo
「Players, it is just as I said.
Keep that lesson in mind...」

entries.speaker: Toma
entries.text:
Toma
「It seems the Wingless
have reached the limits
of their strength...」

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.text:
Futaba
「Whaaat!? You should keep playing!
It's definitely about to get fun!」

entries.speaker: Otoha
entries.text:
Otoha
「Futaba, push the Wingless too
hard and wear them out, and we
won't get good Prana, will we?」

entries.speaker: Moroha
entries.text:
Moroha
「They're a precious source
of Prana for us! Don't confuse
a game with play, Futaba!」

entries.speaker: Toma
entries.text:
Toma
「Moroha, sir... games are play...」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Kei Katsuragi here. I jumped the
gun and ended up as a Singularity,
and now I'm in a real bind.」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「So everyone wants me.
Not just girls... All sorts
of armies want me too...」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Next time on Super Robot
Wars Z: 'Come Back, Player'!」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「So hurry up and resume the
game, and come to my rescue!」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「I'm not interested in being
chased by anyone but girls!」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Sigh... So unlucky. How
did the world get this way?
Oh... My fault... Sigh...」

entries.speaker: Athena
entries.text:
Athena
「How irresponsible, Singularity.
If you weren't that sort
of man, my mother...!」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Athena! I've never forgotten
Tina, not for a moment!」

entries.speaker: Mimsy
entries.text:
Mimsy
「Of course, of course! Last time,
the time before that... every time,
you're always murmuring 'Tina'!」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Gah!? Mimsy! No, listen,
that's not what I mean...!」

entries.speaker: Mimsy
entries.text:
Mimsy
「I hate you, Kei!! I want
nothing to do with you!」

entries.speaker: Athena
entries.text:
Athena
「You brought this on
yourself. It's what a frivolous
man like you deserves.」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Why does it turn out like
this!? ...Players, be careful
what you say, all right?」

entries.speaker: Shaya
entries.text:
Shaya
「Hello, everyone. I'm Shaya,
chief of the Glomar. We
run an Emaan caravan.」

entries.speaker: Shaya
entries.text:
Shaya
「Please continue to give us at
the Glomar your patronage...」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Advertising even now? Good
grief... You Emaan people really
do have a merchant's instincts.」

entries.speaker: Shaya
entries.text:
Shaya
「Oh, Kei... Now is the time for
a proper greeting. Everyone, I
look forward to your patronage.」

entries.speaker: Kei
entries.text:
Kei
「Sigh... What good is asking
for their patronage when
they're stopping the game...?」

entries.speaker: Mome
entries.text:
Mome
「Well then, dear player!
Let's meet again!」

entries.speaker: Dorothy
entries.text:
Dorothy
「I see... You're stopping here...」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「I won't let that happen! I,
Roger Smith, will make sure
you continue the game!」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「Players, as long as this battle
is still unfinished, it is hardly fair
to stop the game at this point.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「To begin with, this battle is...」

entries.speaker: Dorothy
entries.text:
Dorothy
「...That was rather forced. Your
negotiations have failed again.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「What!? R. Dorothy Wayneright!」

entries.speaker: Dorothy
entries.text:
Dorothy
「You should both take a little
rest: the player and you, Roger.」

entries.speaker: Dorothy
entries.text:
Dorothy
「Well then, good night.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「My name is Roger Smith.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「I undertake important work, not
only in Paradigm City, but here
in Super Robot Wars Z as well.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「Even if I were merely an actor
playing Roger Smith here...」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「As long as you call me Roger
Smith, I am Roger Smith!」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「So that I can continue to
be Roger Smith, I ask that you
be sure to resume the game.」

entries.speaker: Roger
entries.text:
Roger
「Because it is not just for my
own sake, but for yours as well.」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Eiji! Eiji! Look! There's someone
in front of the screen!」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「Yeah, that's the player. They
were playing the game until just
now. Of course they're there!」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Oh, I see... Thank you for
playing, everyone! I'm so happy
I got to meet all of you.」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「We'll see each other again
for sure, won't we...?」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「I'm asking you to come back
too! We're not done protecting
Earth from those villains yet!」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「See you next time, then!」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「Good work!」

entries.speaker: Luna
entries.text:
Luna
「Honestly! Pausing right here!
What are you going to do if the
enemy attacks in the meantime!?」

entries.speaker: Eina
entries.text:
Eina
「Um, Lady Luna... The game
stops when the power's
off, so don't worry...」

entries.speaker: Luna
entries.text:
Luna
「Huh!? Really!?」

entries.speaker: Mizuki
entries.text:
Mizuki
「That's common sense... Try to
be a little calmer, like Leele.」

entries.speaker: Leele
entries.text:
Leele
「But I'm a little worried about
whether everyone in front of the
screen will resume the game...」

entries.speaker: Mizuki
entries.text:
Mizuki
「Then why don't we send the player
a message? Here goes, everyone!」

entries.speaker: Luna
entries.text:
Luna
「Super Robot Wars Z!」

entries.speaker: Eina
entries.text:
Eina
「Next time you play, too...」

entries.speaker: Eina
entries.text:
Eina
「At your seeervice!」

entries.speaker: Raven
entries.text:
Raven
「So, you're stopping here. A
pity, when things are about to
get even more interesting...」

entries.speaker: Sandman
entries.text:
Sandman
「No, I'm sure the players know that
too. But the courage to stop for
the sake of what they hold dear...」

entries.speaker: Sandman
entries.text:
Sandman
「In that, I saw the
beauty of the soul.」

entries.speaker: Raven
entries.text:
Raven
「Ah...」

entries.speaker: Sandman
entries.text:
Sandman
「Players, I trust you to
relight the darkness left
when the power is OFF...」

entries.speaker: Sandman
entries.text:
Sandman
「Until then, let these frail fallen
angels have a brief rest...」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「What's the matter, Eiji?
You look awfully serious...」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「I've been wondering for a while...
Can't you do something about
that wishy-washy expression?」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「You're a super
robot pilot, right?」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Huh...?」

entries.speaker: Mizuki
entries.text:
Mizuki
「You're right... Touga does
lack a bit of assertiveness.」

entries.speaker: Leele
entries.text:
Leele
「Touga looks so sharp in
the cockpit, though...」

entries.speaker: Luna
entries.text:
Luna
「Couldn't you add a little
more hot-blooded spirit?」

entries.speaker: Eina
entries.text:
Eina
「Then, by popular demand!
Master Touga, give us a
preview of the next episode!」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Six heroes face advancing Zeravire!
Love and courage's super-heavy
combining god calls a miracle!」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Roar, Super Heavyweight
Sword! Fly, Gravion!」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「Next time on Super Robot
Wars Z: 'Hot-Blooded! Super
Heavyweight God Gravion!'」

entries.speaker: Touga
entries.text:
Touga
「You too, join us!
Ergo Fooooooorm!!」

entries.speaker: Eiji
entries.text:
Eiji
「What do you know! You
can do it when you try!」

entries.speaker: Kappei
entries.text:
Kappei
「Well, well, Uchuta, and Keiko
too! ...What are you doing?」

entries.speaker: Keiko
entries.text:
Keiko
「Honestly! The player's ending the
game, so we're saying goodbye!」

entries.speaker: Uchuta
entries.text:
Uchuta
「Jeez, you came here
without even knowing that?」

entries.speaker: Kappei
entries.text:
Kappei
「What was thaaat?!」

entries.speaker: Keiko
entries.text:
Keiko
「Hey! Kappei! You too,
Uchuta! ...Sorry, everyone.
Get some good rest!」

entries.speaker: Uchuta
entries.text:
Uchuta
「Come back and start playing
again soon, if you can!」

entries.speaker: Kappei
entries.text:
Kappei
「See you, then!」

entries.speaker: Heizaemon
entries.text:
Heizaemon
「A crisis is closing in on not
just Kappei and the others,
but all of Earth's people...」

entries.speaker: Heizaemon
entries.text:
Heizaemon
「We, the Jin Family, search for
a path to peace in a world ruled
by chaos. What lies ahead?」

entries.speaker: Heizaemon
entries.text:
Heizaemon
「Next time on Super Robot Wars
Z: 'A New Battle.' Now then... how
to fight through to the very end?」

entries.speaker: Butcher
entries.text:
Butcher
「Ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!」

entries.speaker: Valetar
entries.text:
Valetar
「Foolish Earthlings! Serious
about stopping us Gaizock?
Resume playing soon!」

entries.speaker: Valetar
entries.text:
Valetar
「Even while you rest, we'll
burn down towns one by one, you
know? Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee!」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「Running away, Kappei?!
The game's not over yet!」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「...That's what I'd like to say,
but you've worked really hard too.
For now, get some good rest.」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「Hey... I hear you're
fighting for Earth alongside
the Jin Family too...」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「Sorry I doubted you earlier...
I want to thank you for
all your hard work too.」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「But come back as soon
as you can. There are still
enemies out to get Earth.」

entries.speaker: Kazuki
entries.text:
Kazuki
「See you. I believe you'll win.」

entries.speaker: Asuham
entries.text:
Asuham
「That's it, Overdevil!
Show me the power to bring
this game to an eeeend!!」

entries.speaker: Ghingnham
entries.text:
Ghingnham
「Nooo!! Turn X alone deserves
to end this game, the symbol
of machine civilization!」

entries.speaker: Asuham
entries.text:
Asuham
「There's no way I can lose! I'm at
my absolute beeeest right now!」

entries.speaker: Ghingnham
entries.text:
Ghingnham
「Then it's... the
Moonlight Butterflyyyy!!」

entries.speaker: Neo
entries.text:
Neo
「Well... never mind those weirdos...
Once you've had a good rest,
come back and play again.」

entries.speaker: Mu
entries.text:
Mu
「Well... never mind those weirdos...
Once you've had a good rest,
come back and play again.」

entries.speaker: Jiron
entries.text:
Jiron
「Good work! Looks like you
really put in a lot of effort
today, too. Get some good rest.」

entries.speaker: Jiron
entries.text:
Jiron
「Eating's the best way to get
your energy back. All right...
I'll bring you something good.」

entries.speaker: Jiron
entries.text:
Jiron
「Don't worry! Not whole roast
lizard or dried snake! Sweet and
fresh, straight from the source...」

entries.speaker: Jiron
entries.text:
Jiron
「Melon Amos! Go
on, eat your fill!」

entries.speaker: Timp
entries.text:
Timp
「Heh... Now that I've run
this far, even that persistent
guy should give up.」

entries.speaker: Timp
entries.text:
Timp
「All you guys and gals
playing, don't go telling
that Domanju where I am.」

entries.speaker: Timp
entries.text:
Timp
「Of course, I'll repay you
for keeping quiet. I've got a
choice piece of information.」

entries.speaker: Timp
entries.text:
Timp
「From what I've heard, a 'Booster'
can be sold for 1,000,000 BS at the
bazaar after the final episode.」

entries.speaker: Timp
entries.text:
Timp
「Keep at least one Booster.
No guarantees there's a bazaar
after the final episode, though!」

entries.speaker: Daisuke
entries.text:
Daisuke
「Earth shines with justice
and love. My friends and I
vowed to keep it peaceful.」

entries.speaker: Daisuke
entries.text:
Daisuke
「Protecting that peace
will take your help as
players of this game, too.」

entries.speaker: Daisuke
entries.text:
Daisuke
「Let's join forces and fight
together. I'll be waiting
for you to play again.」

entries.speaker: Denzel
entries.text:
Denzel
「Attention! (Stand
at attention!)」

entries.speaker: Toby
entries.text:
Toby
「Sir! Yes, sir!」

entries.speaker: Denzel
entries.text:
Denzel
「Parade! Rest! (Line
up! At ease!)」

entries.speaker: Setsuko
entries.text:
Setsuko
「Sir! Yes, sir!」

entries.speaker: Denzel
entries.text:
Denzel
「Present, arms!」

entries.speaker: Setsuko
entries.text:
Setsuko
「Um... What did that mean again?」

entries.speaker: Denzel
entries.text:
Denzel
「It's a rifle salute. Learning
military terms is a soldier's
duty too, Second Lieutenant.」

entries.speaker: Toby
entries.text:
Toby
「If you don't know a term,
look it up in 'Strategy
Q&A' in the 'Library'.」

entries.speaker: Setsuko
entries.text:
Setsuko
「I-I doubt even Strategy Q&A
covers terminology like that...」

entries.speaker: Denzel
entries.text:
Denzel
「Ignore Toby's joke,
Second Lieutenant. Now then,
dismissed! (You may go!)」

entries.speaker: Rand
entries.text:
Rand
「We're Beater Services, the familiar
roving repair crew! Known for honest
service and our staff's smiles.」

entries.speaker: Mel
entries.text:
Mel
「Today, we'll give all you
players a few tips on getting
along with your game consoles.」

entries.speaker: Mel
entries.text:
Mel
「In a word...!」

entries.speaker: Rand
entries.text:
Rand
「Love! That's the key to the bond
between people and machines!」

entries.speaker: Mel
entries.text:
Mel
「...Darling. Gunleon seems
to be acting up...」

entries.speaker: Rand
entries.text:
Rand
「Then give the console
a full-force chop at a
45-degree angle to the right!」

entries.speaker: Mel
entries.text:
Mel
「That's what NOT to do.
Please take good care of your
game consoles, everyone.」

entries.speaker: Rand
entries.text:
Rand
「Well, see you next time!」
